steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); window.__gitgood.store.set((s) => ({ changes: { ...s.changes, summary: 'Update app value' } })); return JSON.stringify({ files: (window.__gitgood.store.get().status || { files: [] }).files.map((f) => f.path) }); })()

(async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.reviewChangesBeforeCommit(); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); if (!s.precommitReview.running && s.precommitReview.run) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const run = s.precommitReview.run; const live = run ? run.findings.filter((f) => !f.dismissed) : []; return JSON.stringify({ findingCount: live.length, blockerCount: live.filter((f) => f.severity === 'blocker').length, commitMessageMatches: run ? run.commitMessageMatches : null, hasBlockerButton: !!document.querySelector('.commit-btn.has-blockers') }); })()

(async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.commit(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); if (!s.changes.committing) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ committed: !!s.status && s.status.files.length === 0, summary: s.changes.summary }); })()
